answer: Each epoch the seed pairs every answer with five graders drawn outside its funding lineage, and each grader escrows five POA on the verdict. Two percent get re-judged by a second panel; if the medians disagree, the original five forfeit eighty percent of their bond and the honest ones split it. A clone farm cannot grade itself, so it must rent outside signatures at five POA each, twenty-five per answer, refunded only when both juries concur. Marble is trusted because a hundred masons cut it before a builder lays it; the dawn comes whether anyone watches the horizon.
